description: Fuobe Shorts (build plan O9) on your clip (local/shorts/clip.mp4). shorts/segment is one segment's Wan 2.2 Fun VACE pass from a first frame you made or own (local/shorts/frame0.png), straight through /api/generations; shorts/session is the whole studio chain through POST /api/shorts/sessions (each segment's first frame drawn in the look by Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, Fun VACE by depth, the segments stitched under the clip's sound), on the first 6 s (local/shorts/clip.mp4 must be at least that long). Flicker, style and prompt match are measured. The partner variant runs Gemini Omni Flash, Higgsfield's Shorts engine and still a choice in the studio, for comparison.
